ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixel background (~70%) with high-intensity (white) pixel clusters (~30%) distributed non-uniformly across the ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white mottling concentrated in the inner-left quadrant. Extensive spatial distribution of high-contrast circular ring-shaped pixel clusters ('donut' shapes) mapped across the lower and medial portions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with a deep pixel-depth relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous boundary exhibiting low-amplitude, irregular serrations; right lobe trailing edge displays a higher frequency of pixel-level jaggedness compared to the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex-upward curvature originating from the median notch and sweeping laterally toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive detection of localized circular high-contrast pixel rings distributed globally across the fluke, with dense clustering in the lower medial regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several thin, light-colored linear pixel disruptions crossing the dark pigmentation, notably horizontal and diagonal streaks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Physical presence of textured, high-relief barnacle clusters at the lateral terminal tips of both lobes; extensive depigmented circular scarring across the entire visible surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly repetitive 'O-shaped' scar morphology creates a unique textural pixel signature across the dark ventral background.
